meta.name: writing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把需求整理成一步步可执行的实施计划,动手写码前先理清路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到需求或规格后想先列清步骤再写代码
copy.tagline_en: Turn a spec into a step-by-step implementation plan before writing any code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear plan from a spec before touching code

howto.what: Claude 会把你提供的规格或多步骤需求写成一份实施计划：拆成带测试、验证与提交步骤的小任务，默认保存到 docs/superpowers/plans/日期-名称.md，并在写完后做一轮自审。
howto.when: 当你手里已有规格或多步骤任务的需求、且还没开始动代码时会触发；若规格包含多个独立子系统，它会建议拆成多份计划。

say.text: 把这个规格写成实施计划
say.note: 它先声明使用该技能，再输出计划文件

say.text: 计划写完后对照规格自审一遍
say.note: 检查覆盖、步骤与类型一致性

say.text: 用 subagent-driven 方式执行这份计划
say.note: 每个任务由新子代理实现并复核

howto.what_en: Claude turns the spec you provide into an implementation plan: bite-sized tasks with test-first, verification and commit steps, saved to docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature-name>.md, then self-reviewed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task and haven't touched code yet. If the spec spans independent subsystems, it suggests splitting it into separate plans.

say_en.text: Turn this spec into an implementation plan
say_en.note: Announces the skill, then writes the plan file

say_en.text: Self-review the plan against the spec
say_en.note: Checks coverage, steps and type consistency
A fresh subagent implements each task
